search_jobs.description: Search every federal job opening posted on USAJOBS right now. Filter by keyword, title, location and radius, agency, occupational series, pay plan, grade, salary, work type and schedule, security clearance, travel, who may apply, whether it is remote, and how recently it was posted. Returns each job with its announcement number, links to view and apply, locations and coordinates, pay range, opening and closing dates, and the full announcement text.
